verdict.rationale: Self-hosting docs show integration guides for Azure OpenAI and Ollama, which implies you can bring your own provider credentials or local models. Nothing in the pack shows token-usage or cost tracking per model or per conversation. Missing for 10: any evidence of token usage or cost dashboards (per model or per conversation), explicit documentation of entering BYO API keys across providers, support for using existing subscriptions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
